notes: Started once after exact staged-file SHA-256/MD5 readback, fresh viewed clear-bed evidence, sole-controller and live white Generic PLA A2 routing checks. Independent telemetry confirmed RUNNING layer 2/224, 5%, no active error at 06:31:40 UTC. Actual camera at 06:31:46 shows a broad white bottom with flat-looking visible edges and no obvious broad tangle/lift; the head partly occludes the center/right. This establishes scoped initial stability only; overall quality and fit remain unverified. One watertight iceberg, 97.08 × 97.03 × 44.90 mm. Three walls, 15% gyroid, tree supports in same white PLA with 0.2 mm gap. 215 C first layer, 210 C thereafter, 55 C bed. Independent geometry/toolpath/profile audit passed. Intermittently unavailable storage recovered on recheck; original staged file matched exactly and required no upload. Actual duration/material and physical quality remain unverified.
